title: [YSQL] [randgen] Bitmap Scan plan returns an extra row
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10647](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10647)
### Description

Problem
----
* Wrong results from a Bitmap Scan plan. The row: `(25,,x)` is returned in the result set despite the conditions: `table1.col_varchar_key < 'h' AND col_varchar_key IN ('j', 'x')`.
* Similar plan on the vanilla PG15.6 shows a recheck condition that is missing in the YB plan (that is not necessarily the source of the problem though): `Recheck Cond: ((col_int_key >= 8) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'w'::text) OR (((col_varchar_key)::text < 'h'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = ANY ('{j,x}'::text[]))))`. 
* Reproducible on a recent master (d968b9322d).

With Bitmap Scan (YB) - returns 19 rows:
```
/*+ Set(enable_seqscan OFF) */
SELECT
    table1
FROM
    t1 AS table1
WHERE
    table1.col_int_key >= 8
    OR
    table1.col_varchar_key < 'w'
    OR
    table1.col_varchar_key < 'h'
    AND
    col_varchar_key IN (
        'j',
        'x'
    )
;

  table1  
----------
 (25,,x)
 (15,,u)
 (21,4,q)
 (12,1,r)
 (27,0,p)
 (18,2,o)
 (16,1,m)
 (19,9,w)
 (26,,f)
 (24,8,g)
 (11,7,d)
 (23,4,d)
 (28,,j)
 (17,9,)
 (20,2,m)
 (13,7,f)
 (14,9,y)
 (29,8,c)
 (10,8,x)
(19 rows)

                                                       QUERY PLAN                                                        
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 YB Bitmap Table Scan on t1 table1
   ->  BitmapOr
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: (col_int_key >= 8)
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_varchar_key_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'w'::text)
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_varchar_key_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: (((col_varchar_key)::text < 'h'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = ANY ('{j,x}'::text[])))
(8 rows)
```
Seq Scan (YB) - returns 18 rows (No `(25,,x)`):
```
  table1  
----------
 (10,8,x)
 (11,7,d)
 (12,1,r)
 (13,7,f)
 (14,9,y)
 (15,,u)
 (16,1,m)
 (17,9,)
 (18,2,o)
 (19,9,w)
 (20,2,m)
 (21,4,q)
 (23,4,d)
 (24,8,g)
 (26,,f)
 (27,0,p)
 (28,,j)
 (29,8,c)
(18 rows)

                                                                                    QUERY PLAN                                                                                    
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Seq Scan on t1 table1
   Storage Filter: ((col_int_key >= 8) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'w'::text) OR (((col_varchar_key)::text < 'h'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = ANY ('{j,x}'::text[]))))
(2 rows)
```
Vanilla PG15.6 Bitmap Scan:
```
  table1  
----------
 (10,8,x)
 (11,7,d)
 (12,1,r)
 (13,7,f)
 (14,9,y)
 (15,,u)
 (16,1,m)
 (17,9,)
 (18,2,o)
 (19,9,w)
 (20,2,m)
 (21,4,q)
 (23,4,d)
 (24,8,g)
 (26,,f)
 (27,0,p)
 (28,,j)
 (29,8,c)
(18 rows)

                                                                                   QUERY PLAN                                                                                   
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Bitmap Heap Scan on t1 table1
   Recheck Cond: ((col_int_key >= 8) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'w'::text) OR (((col_varchar_key)::text < 'h'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = ANY ('{j,x}'::text[]))))
   ->  BitmapOr
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: (col_int_key >= 8)
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_varchar_key_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: ((col_varchar_key)::text < 'w'::text)
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on t1_col_varchar_key_col_int_key_idx
               Index Cond: (((col_varchar_key)::text < 'h'::text) AND ((col_varchar_key)::text = ANY ('{j,x}'::text[])))
(9 rows)
```
Test Case
---
```
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t1;

CREATE TABLE t1 (    pk integer NOT NULL,    col_int_key integer,    col_varchar_key character varying(1),    CONSTRAINT t1_pkey PRIMARY KEY(pk ASC));

COPY t1 (pk, col_int_key, col_varchar_key) FROM stdin;
10	8	x
11	7	d
12	1	r
13	7	f
14	9	y
15	\N	u
16	1	m
17	9	\N
18	2	o
19	9	w
20	2	m
21	4	q
22	0	\N
23	4	d
24	8	g
25	\N	x
26	\N	f
27	0	p
28	\N	j
29	8	c
\.

CREATE INDEX t1_col_int_key_idx ON t1 (col_int_key ASC);
CREATE INDEX t1_col_varchar_key_col_int_key_idx ON t1 (col_varchar_key ASC, col_int_key ASC);

/*+ Set(enable_seqscan OFF) */
SELECT
    table1
FROM
    t1 AS table1
WHERE
    table1.col_int_key >= 8
    OR
    table1.col_varchar_key < 'w'
    OR
    table1.col_varchar_key < 'h'
    AND
    col_varchar_key IN (
        'j',
        'x'
    )
;
```
